rationale: Shared services cost is booked at Northstar Shared Services and recharged to the operating entities. Management holds the consuming business unit accountable for it, so the management view presents it where it is consumed rather than where it was booked. A presentation reclassification: it nets to nil within the income statement and changes no subtotal.

Amortisation of intangibles recognised on acquisition is presented apart from organic depreciation and amortisation, so that the underlying asset base is visible. A presentation reclassification within D&A: it nets to nil and changes neither EBITDA nor EBIT.
